parsed.explanation: No trans-specific offence, no documented presentation policing, no facility or custody rule, and a functioning rule-of-law setting with court-enforced rights and an LGBT community centre point away from active exposure. Sexuality-law positives (decriminalisation, 2024 marriage ruling) are secondary climate signals, not trans protections, and the record is explicitly LGB-focused. Genuinely trans-relevant axes — gender markers on local IDs, border screening, gender-affirming care, facility designation — are unassessed, not cleared, and anti-discrimination grounds omit gender identity (a resident-facing gap, light weight; it reaches visitors only if officials doubt foreign documents, which is undocumented). Administrative obstruction of Pride shows thin institutional warmth toward public LGBT presence but does not target trans travellers. Net: reduced risk, held a step below acceptance-with-working-protections tiers by open questions and absent trans-specific evidence, but no known traveller-facing exposure.
